settings.question: How long will my bed take to arrive?
settings.answer: Express Dispatch beds are delivered within 1–3 working days of your order; everything else arrives within 1–4 working days. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding bank holidays. The service for your item is shown at checkout, and we email tracking as soon as it's on its way.

settings.question: What does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Nothing, to any UK mainland address. There's no minimum spend and no delivery charge — the price you see is the price you pay. For Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and UK islands, email us before ordering and we'll confirm your postcode and any additional cost, so there are no surprises afterwards.

settings.question: How is a bed actually delivered?
settings.answer: By a specialist large-item courier, to your front door. They'll contact you in advance with your delivery day, and someone over 18 needs to be in to receive it. Beds arrive flat-packed in protective packaging with clear assembly instructions and all fittings included.

settings.question: Can I return it if it's not right?
settings.answer: Yes — you have 30 days from delivery. The item needs to be unused, in its original condition and original packaging, so keep the packaging until you're sure. We'll quote the collection cost before you confirm anything and deduct it from your refund, or you're welcome to arrange your own tracked courier. Refunds are issued within 14 days of the bed reaching us.

settings.question: What if it arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Check your delivery on arrival. If any packaging or parts are damaged, email azixparz@outlook.com within 48 hours with photos and your order number. We'll put it right with a replacement part, a full replacement or a full refund — and for faulty or damaged goods, collection is arranged and paid for by us.

settings.question: Can I cancel before it ships?
settings.answer: Any time. Email or call us before your order has been dispatched and we'll cancel it with a full and immediate refund — nothing to return and nothing to pay.

settings.question: What size do I need?
settings.answer: UK sizes are: small single 2ft6, single 3ft (90×190cm), small double 4ft, double 4ft6 (135×190cm), king 5ft (150×200cm) and super king 6ft (180×200cm). Leave around 60cm of walking space each side where the room allows, and 90cm in front of wardrobe doors so they open fully.

settings.question: Can I return a mattress?
settings.answer: For hygiene reasons, a mattress can only be returned as a change of mind while it's still sealed in its original protective packaging. Once it's unsealed it can only be returned if it's faulty — which is covered in full under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

settings.heading: 30 days to change your mind
settings.text: If the bed isn't right for the room, you have 30 days from delivery to tell us. We'll quote the collection cost before you commit to anything and refund you within 14 days of it reaching us. Anything damaged in transit is collected and replaced at our cost — just send photos within 48 hours.
